maya: Rollout v2.14.3 -> eu-west-1 completed. Kicking off quick post-deploy smoke sweep. @oncall FYI :eyes:

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary shift to 5% applied. healthcheck summary: all pods Ready. probe-runner starting synthetic probes (short-suite).

jia: Running short prompt suite now: `./scripts/run-smoke --suite=short --region=eu-west-1` — will post results in ~5m.

ops-bot: synth-probe results: 10/10 queries OK, p50=45ms p95=120ms errors=0 :white_check_mark:

tom: Seeing a small burst of 429s from adapter-eu-1 around 10:02:12 UTC, sample logs attached:
```
10:02:10 adapter-eu-1 request_id=abc123 status=200 lat=48ms
10:02:12 adapter-eu-1 request_id=abc124 status=429 lat=15ms reason=rate_limit
10:02:13 adapter-eu-2 request_id=abc125 status=200 lat=52ms
10:02:14 adapter-eu-1 request_id=abc126 status=429 lat=18ms reason=rate_limit
```

maya: Thanks Tom. link to logs: https://logs.redwood/streams/adapter-eu-1/abc — can we hold the global ramp if this trend persists? propose pinning us-east and eu-west non-critical routes to v2.14.2 while we triage.

sara: Agree to hold the ramp until we rule out a throttling regression. I'll open a quick alert if errors exceed threshold. For mitigation, can we bump prefill/warmup on the new hosts? Example patch: `kubectl patch deployment prefill --type=json -p '[{"op":"replace","path":"/spec/template/spec/containers/0/env/0/value","value":"true"}]'`

jia: Short-suite summary: 3/40 prompts flagged for tokenization diffs (minor). No semantic regressions so far. Kicking off extended suite now (`--suite=extended`), ETA ~12m.

maya: Decision for now: pause global ramp. Pin eu-west-1 canary at 5% for 30m to collect more telemetry. If 429 rate <= 0.1% and synth errors=0, continue to 25%. If error rate > 0.5% for 5m, rollback to v2.14.2. Also adding release note: "Tokenizer minor tweak; monitor adapter throttles."

deploy-bot: rollout: paused by maya. pin set: eu-west-1 -> v2.14.3 at 5% until 1758882500.

tom: Quick mitigation I'm trying: revert the adapter timeout patch on the problematic nodepool: `svcctl set-config adapter timeout=1200 --pool=adapter-eu-1 && svcctl drain node adapter-eu-1-3` — will post result.

sara: :thumbsup: I'll watch dashboards (Dash: https://console.redwood/dashboards/deploys) and post any alerts. If extended suite passes clean, we can reconvene and proceed with staged ramp.

maya: Owner: maya. Action items: 1) jia -> post extended-suite results, 2) tom -> mitigation outcome, 3) sara -> monitor and escalate. Revisit in 15m.
